topic: Raising the savings rate one percent every year vs staying flat (Emmett vs Thalia)

scenes.narration: One percent a year became a two hundred thousand dollar gap. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym pointing at a rising step chart of tiny one percent stairs, comic burst banner reads TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND GAP, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett and Thalia both earn sixty thousand and save five percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split gym panel of man emmett and woman thalia on identical rowing machines, both dials stamped FIVE PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each one gets a three percent raise every single year.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, emmett and thalia each holding a gold envelope labeled THREE PERCENT RAISE beside a gym chalkboard, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett locks his contribution at five percent and never touches it.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, emmett padlocking a savings dial stamped FIVE PERCENT on a gym wall panel, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every raise goes straight into bigger rent and newer phones.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, emmett walking out of a gym with shopping bags and a new phone, an arrow labeled RAISE flowing into them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thalia bumps her savings rate one percent on every raise day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thalia turning a gym dial one notch from FIVE PERCENT to SIX PERCENT, a calendar stamped RAISE DAY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The change costs about fifty dollars monthly, invisible inside her paycheck.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thalia holding a paycheck with a tiny slice labeled FIFTY DOLLARS shaded out, comic banner reads BARELY NOTICED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Ten years later she is saving fifteen percent without any pain.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thalia easily lifting a barbell stamped FIFTEEN PERCENT, a wall calendar reading TEN YEARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Emmett's balance after twenty years is one hundred fifty five thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, emmett staring at a gym scoreboard reading ONE HUNDRED FIFTY FIVE THOUSAND after twenty years, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Thalia's hit three hundred fifty seven thousand on the same salary.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, thalia beaming beside a taller gym scoreboard reading THREE HUNDRED FIFTY SEVEN THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Two hundred thousand extra, from fifty dollars more that first month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, side by side gym podiums, the tall one labeled TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND EXTRA and a tiny coin labeled FIFTY DOLLARS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Add one percent to your savings on your next raise. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym, holding a clipboard reading PLUS ONE PERCENT EVERY RAISE, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
